name: The Nephilim
overview: The Nephilim are described in Scripture as giants who lived on the earth in ancient times, notably before and after the flood. Genesis 6 reveals that these mighty men of renown were born from the union of the 'sons of God' and the daughters of men, highlighting a unique and significant event in human history. Numbers 13 further confirms the existence of giants descended from these Nephilim, emphasizing their imposing presence and the fear they inspired even in God's people.
